# View the as-built codebase map `VAB`

[As built](../README.md) › View the as-built codebase map

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Lets a user browse Fabrika's analysis of the committed codebase -- its subsystems, capabilities and files -- and trigger a refresh of that map, via screen:As-built section.
